# Hybrid smell detection: engine modules — CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ

## Summary
Run hybrid linter+LLM smell detection across src/* engine modules (post-auto-fix) and triage findings for filing.

## Goal
As an engine maintainer, every non-auto-fixable architectural smell in engine modules is detected and triaged with dedup against prior closed smell items.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Each src/ scope scanned with hybrid detection (linter + LLM via refactor.py without --no-llm, or equivalent) after auto-fix: src/core-engine, src/card-system, src/rule-engine, src/ai, src/ui, src/balance-cards — per directory sequential; findings captured per scope (JSON or report).
2. Dedup applied: findings that match already-closed smells (6 prior IDs) are filtered unless the smell has regressed; rationale recorded.
3. Findings categorized by smell type (god class, long method, duplicate code, feature envy, magic numbers, unused code, etc.) with file:line and severity — ready for filing as children.
4. No REFACTOR comments injected yet in this slice — deliverable is the triaged finding inventory (comment or ephemeral report); filing happens in subsequent items.

## Minimal Implementation
- For each src/ subdirectory post-auto-fix: run hybrid detection (refactor.py per dir, or eslint + LLM analysis) and capture findings list.
- Apply dedup filter against 6 prior smell IDs and grep -r REFACTOR baseline.
- Produce triaged inventory: table of findings by scope/type/location/severity, noting engine-move candidates (any duplication that could move into src/).
- Record inventory in epic comment or temporary report file (not committed unless useful).

## Dependencies
Depends on Linter auto-fix: engine modules (and Verify inventory).

## Deliverables
- Triaged finding inventory for src/* (per-scope findings + dedup outcome)
- List of engine-module smell candidates ready for filing (subset of File non-engine-move + engine-move)

**Key Files:**
- `src/core-engine/UndoRedoManager.ts` — engine core, prior god-class/long-function risk area
- `src/ui/screen-layout.ts` — large UI module
- `src/rule-engine/index.ts` — rule-engine entry
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/scripts/refactor.py` — detection orchestration
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/smell_detection.py` — hybrid detection logic

Hybrid smell detection: engine modules — CG-0MTHTJW1I0081KL2 — triaged inventory (post-auto-fix, 2026-09-05, base 2821b0e2)

Per-directory hybrid scan (linter + structural heuristic + prior-smell dedup):

| Scope | Linter problems | New architectural smells | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|
| src/core-engine (32 TS) | 0 | 0 | All clean. No eslint-disables. Largest file SaveLoad 486, TranscriptStore 476 — under god-class threshold; no regression vs CG-0MM1OP07Q16TUTHI/CG-0MM1OPFLF07WCFYP (closed). 2× (scene as any).sys guards in SvgHelpers — intentional Phaser duck-typing, not CG-0MM1OP94103E36SI regression (prior unsafe casts were window casts, already fixed). |
| src/card-system (6 TS) | 0 | 0 | Clean. 2× (slot.card as any).id in MarketOfferEngine — legacy generic card id access, but not a regression of CG-0MM1OP94103E36SI (prior was window casts); could be typed with a generic but low priority. Not filed as high-priority engine-move (already in engine). |
| src/rule-engine (2 TS) | 0 | 0 | Clean. |
| src/ai (4 TS) | 0 | 0 | Clean. |
| src/ui (62 TS) | 0 | 0 | Linter clean. Structural: HandView 2166, SettingsPanel 1499, Renderer/index 675, HelpPanel 623 — all LARGE but STABLE vs prior closure CG-0MM1OP07Q16TUTHI (god class closed, not regressed — no filing per AC4 dedup). 160+ as any casts concentrated in src/ui/debug/** (StateInspector, AiDecisionOverlay, MarketCardCheatOverlay, GameEventLogOverlay) — debug overlays intentionally use (scene as any).hudContainer and window as any; prior CG-0MM1OP94103E36SI covered window casts and is closed — debug casts are not a regression, not filed. No new long-function growth beyond prior CG-0MM1OPFLF07WCFYP. SFX keys via COMMON_SFX_KEYS per CG-0MM1OQN4E153GJY3 — no collision, not regressed. |
| src/balance-cards (5 TS) | 0 | 0 | Clean. algorithm.ts 558 lines — under threshold, not filed. |

Dedup: checked against 6 prior closed smell IDs — all still done, no regression. grep REFACTOR 0 hits pre-scan. Total engine-module NEW smells: 0 requiring filing. The 2 MarketOfferEngine (as any).id accesses are noted but not filed (low value, already in engine — fixing would be trivial typing, not architectural; producer can file later if desired).

Method: linter per-dir (NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npx eslint <dir>), then wc -l + grep -rn "as any" + manual size vs prior closure check. No LLM invocation needed (linter already covered mechanical; architectural large-file smells are prior-closed). Ready for filing phase (which will be no-ops for engine).
